description: This file defines an event listener class EmployeeSalaryListener that hooks into Doctrine ORM lifecycle events for the EmployeeSalary entity. Its main purpose is to transparently encrypt and decrypt the 'amount' field during persistence, updates, and loading, ensuring data security.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryListener
classes.description: An event listener for the EmployeeSalary entity that manages encryption/decryption of the 'amount' field during entity lifecycle events.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Encrypts the 'amount' field before the entity is persisted to the database if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Encrypts the 'amount' field before the entity is updated, if the amount has changed and encryption is enabled.

methods.name: postUpdate
methods.description: Decrypts the 'amount' field after the entity has been updated in the database, if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: postLoad
methods.description: Decrypts the 'amount' field after the entity is loaded from the database, if encryption is enabled.
